# Sourdough starter

A starter is flour and water colonised by wild yeast and lactobacilli. Keep it in a glass jar on the counter with the lid resting loosely on top.

## Feeding schedule

Discard all but 50 g, then stir in 50 g of flour and 50 g of water. At room temperature, feed it every twelve hours; kept in the fridge, once a week is enough.

## Signs it is ready

It doubles within four to six hours of a feed, smells pleasantly sour, and a spoonful floats when dropped into water.
